activation_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the installed activation helper; `null` when not checked.

compatibility_name.description: File name the server runs under so the game accepts it (`start` only).

game_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the installed `NFS16.exe`; `null` when no game was checked.

machine_changes.description: Always empty: the launcher changes no machine-wide setting.

registered_client_path.description: The existing EA client registration the game uses, read-only.

requires_administrator.description: Always `false`: the launcher never needs administrator rights.

server_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the server executable, lowercase hexadecimal.
